005package org.wpilib.simulation;
006
007/** Manages simulation callbacks; each object is associated with a callback. */
008public class CallbackStore implements AutoCloseable {
009  /** <b>Note: This interface is for simulation classes only. It should not be used by teams!</b> */
010  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.ImplicitFunctionalInterface")
011  protected interface CancelCallbackFunc {
012    /**
013     * Cancels a callback using the provided index and unique identifier.
014     *
015     * @param index The index of the resource associated with the callback.
016     * @param uid The unique identifier of the callback to cancel.
017     */
018    void cancel(int index, int uid);
019  }
020
021  /** <b>Note: This interface is for simulation classes only. It should not be used by teams!</b> */
022  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.ImplicitFunctionalInterface")
023  protected interface CancelCallbackChannelFunc {
024    /**
025     * Cancels a registered callback identified by the provided parameters.
026     *
027     * @param index the index of the digital I/O channel
028     * @param channel the specific channel associated with the callback
029     * @param uid the unique identifier for the callback to cancel
030     */
031    void cancel(int index, int channel, int uid);
032  }
033
034  /** <b>Note: This interface is for simulation classes only. It should not be used by teams!</b> */
035  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.ImplicitFunctionalInterface")
036  protected interface CancelCallbackNoIndexFunc {
037    /**
038     * Cancels the callback associated with the given unique identifier.
039     *
040     * @param uid the unique identifier for the callback to be canceled
041     */
042    void cancel(int uid);
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Constructs an empty CallbackStore. This constructor is to allow 3rd party sim providers (eg
047   * vendors) to subclass this class (without needing to provide dummy constructing parameters) so
048   * that the register methods of their sim classes can return CallbackStores like the builtin sims.
049   * <b>Note: It should not be called by teams that are just using sims!</b>
050   */
051  protected CallbackStore() {
052    this.m_cancelType = -1;
053    this.m_index = -1;
054    this.m_uid = -1;
055    this.m_cancelCallback = null;
056    this.m_cancelCallbackChannel = null;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * <b>Note: This constructor is for simulation classes only. It should not be called by teams!</b>
061   *
062   * @param index TODO
063   * @param uid TODO
064   * @param ccf TODO
065   */
066  protected CallbackStore(int index, int uid, CancelCallbackFunc ccf) {
067    this.m_cancelType = NORMAL_CANCEL;
068    this.m_index = index;
069    this.m_uid = uid;
070    this.m_cancelCallback = ccf;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * <b>Note: This constructor is for simulation classes only. It should not be called by teams!</b>
075   *
076   * @param index TODO
077   * @param channel TODO
078   * @param uid TODO
079   * @param ccf TODO
080   */
081  protected CallbackStore(int index, int channel, int uid, CancelCallbackChannelFunc ccf) {
082    this.m_cancelType = CHANNEL_CANCEL;
083    this.m_index = index;
084    this.m_uid = uid;
085    this.m_channel = channel;
086    this.m_cancelCallbackChannel = ccf;
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * <b>Note: This constructor is for simulation classes only. It should not be called by teams!</b>
091   *
092   * @param uid TODO
093   * @param ccf TODO
094   */
095  protected CallbackStore(int uid, CancelCallbackNoIndexFunc ccf) {
096    this.m_cancelType = NO_INDEX_CANCEL;
097    this.m_uid = uid;
098    this.m_cancelCallbackNoIndex = ccf;
099  }
100
101  private int m_index;
102  private int m_channel;
103  private final int m_uid;
104  private CancelCallbackFunc m_cancelCallback;
105  private CancelCallbackChannelFunc m_cancelCallbackChannel;
106  private CancelCallbackNoIndexFunc m_cancelCallbackNoIndex;
107  private static final int ALREADY_CANCELLED = -1;
108  private static final int NORMAL_CANCEL = 0;
109  private static final int CHANNEL_CANCEL = 1;
110  private static final int NO_INDEX_CANCEL = 2;
111  private int m_cancelType;
112
113  /** Cancel the callback associated with this object. */
114  @Override
115  public void close() {
116    switch (m_cancelType) {
117      case ALREADY_CANCELLED -> {
118        // Already cancelled so do nothing so that close() is idempotent.
119        return;
120      }
121      case NORMAL_CANCEL -> m_cancelCallback.cancel(m_index, m_uid);
122      case CHANNEL_CANCEL -> m_cancelCallbackChannel.cancel(m_index, m_channel, m_uid);
123      case NO_INDEX_CANCEL -> m_cancelCallbackNoIndex.cancel(m_uid);
124      default -> {
125        assert false;
126      }
127    }
128    m_cancelType = ALREADY_CANCELLED;
129  }
130}
